source.about: Claims of the first four deep-research investigations on real models whose recorded verifier answer is support: yes while the check revision was written insufficient (values_missing). Records come from the training fixture MCP source; no employee data. Used by src/recorded-runs.spec.ts (UC-R1, design-engine.md 1.5.3, Regression on Recorded Runs).
source.exportCommand: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U agent -d agent_os -At -f - < <query file>
source.claimFields: text, atoms, pointer: the worker revision (status unverified) just before the check revision; checkStatus: the check revision status; assessment: assessment.answer of the check revision; pages: items of every page the pointer names, by page id.

queries.claims: with latest as (select distinct on (claim_id) * from app.research_claims where investigation_id in ('62f7d864-3af3-40e0-8b34-36e2744f17ba','3581b8c6-c27c-4796-8e07-ee03d6f1dab0','6b292528-fc32-4dea-8fe3-daab7c5fae3b','8e13df70-0239-430c-863a-ecba7ca9647b') order by claim_id, seq desc), checked as (select * from latest where status = 'insufficient' and assessment->'answer'->>'support' = 'yes') select json_agg(json_build_object('claimId', k.claim_id, 'investigationId', k.investigation_id, 'checkStatus', k.status, 'text', w.text, 'atoms', w.atoms, 'pointer', w.pointer, 'assessment', k.assessment->'answer', 'pages', (select json_object_agg(p->>'pageId', convert_from(ec.bytes, 'UTF8')::json->'items') from jsonb_array_elements(w.pointer) p join app.research_evidence_contents ec on ec.evidence_id = (p->>'pageId')::uuid)) order by k.seq) from checked k cross join lateral (select * from app.research_claims r where r.claim_id = k.claim_id and r.status = 'unverified' and r.seq < k.seq order by r.seq desc limit 1) w
queries.count: with latest as (select distinct on (claim_id) * from app.research_claims where investigation_id in ('62f7d864-3af3-40e0-8b34-36e2744f17ba','3581b8c6-c27c-4796-8e07-ee03d6f1dab0','6b292528-fc32-4dea-8fe3-daab7c5fae3b','8e13df70-0239-430c-863a-ecba7ca9647b') order by claim_id, seq desc) select count(*) from latest where status = 'insufficient' and assessment->'answer'->>'support' = 'yes'
queries.source: select json_build_object('runs', (select json_agg(json_build_object('investigationId', r.investigation_id, 'processId', r.process_id, 'processVersion', r.process_version, 'createdAt', r.created_at) order by r.created_at) from app.research_engine_runs r where r.investigation_id in ('62f7d864-3af3-40e0-8b34-36e2744f17ba','3581b8c6-c27c-4796-8e07-ee03d6f1dab0','6b292528-fc32-4dea-8fe3-daab7c5fae3b','8e13df70-0239-430c-863a-ecba7ca9647b')), 'promptVersions', (select json_object_agg(role, versions) from (select role, json_agg(distinct prompt_version) versions from app.research_llm_transcripts where investigation_id in ('62f7d864-3af3-40e0-8b34-36e2744f17ba','3581b8c6-c27c-4796-8e07-ee03d6f1dab0','6b292528-fc32-4dea-8fe3-daab7c5fae3b','8e13df70-0239-430c-863a-ecba7ca9647b') group by role) t), 'exportedAt', now())
queries.pages: select json_agg(json_build_object('pageId', e.evidence_id, 'investigationId', e.investigation_id, 'sourceId', e.provenance->>'sourceId', 'toolName', e.provenance->>'toolName', 'snapshot', e.provenance->>'snapshot', 'normalizedArgs', e.provenance->'normalizedArgs') order by e.created_at) from app.research_evidence e where e.evidence_id in ('cd200908-e42f-4cc0-8375-2cd1ef1c6cb7','76971532-f63f-48a2-b1ae-9719936d342d','6a2959e6-33df-4265-b9a3-38712123574a','088b2a86-5c3a-4d80-809d-1031dde3ebe5')

claims.text: Пик ошибок 2026-09-14 пришёлся на интервал 22:00–22:15 UTC, где зафиксировано 8 ошибок, это максимум за день.
С 00:00 до 01:00 UTC 15 сентября 2026 записано 39 ошибок (статус error).

Количество записей payment.result резко возрастает с 3 в 23:00 14 сентября до 39 в 00:00 15 сентября, то есть рост совпадает по времени с выкладкой 2026-09-15 00:00, но записи не содержат сервис, уровень ошибки и тип таймаута, поэтому они сами по себе не подтверждают, что рост вызван выкладкой.
Сервис ledger записал в бакетах с 13:00 по 23:00 2026-09-14 в сумме 44 записи уровня error.
Сервис payment-api записал в бакетах с 00:00 по 10:00 2026-09-14 в сумме 24 записи уровня error.
Сервис payment-api записал в бакетах с 11:00 по 23:00 2026-09-14 в сумме 40 записей уровня error.
